topic: Pay yourself first vs pay yourself last (Heath vs Willa)

scenes.narration: Paying yourself first saves four times more than saving leftovers. Today's training session begins now!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named coach vault, athletic build, buzzcut brown hair, red track jacket with gold dollar sign logo, silver whistle, clipboard covered in dollar sign stickers, fingerless training gloves, sweatband, coach vault in a gym holding a giant arrow pointing at SAVINGS FIRST then BILLS, comic burst banner reads FOUR TIMES MORE, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Heath and Willa each take home five thousand dollars every month.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel of man heath and woman willa each holding identical paychecks stamped FIVE THOUSAND, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Both want to save one thousand dollars per month for the future.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, both holding identical goal notes that read SAVE ONE THOUSAND PER MONTH, hopeful expressions, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Heath pays his rent, food, gas, and fun first every paycheck.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, heath at a kitchen table paying bills, food, gas, and a pile of fun receipts, comic banner reads BILLS FIRST, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Then he tries to save whatever pocket change is leftover.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, heath shaking out an empty wallet over a piggy bank, only a few coins falling out, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: By the twenty fifth there is rarely anything left to move.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, heath at a kitchen table with an empty checking screen and a calendar reading TWENTY FIFTH, comic banner reads NOTHING LEFT, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Willa auto transfers one thousand dollars the morning after payday.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, willa at a phone screen tapping AUTO TRANSFER ONE THOUSAND right after a payday icon, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She moves the money before paying a single bill or buying coffee.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, willa walking past a coffee shop with a confident smile, savings app on her phone shows SAVED FIRST, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Then she pays her bills with whatever she has left.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, willa at a kitchen table calmly paying bills with a savings receipt already tucked into a SAVED jar, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Twelve months later Heath has saved only nine hundred dollars total.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, shocked heath at a savings app reading NINE HUNDRED, calendar pages flipping past with no transfers, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Willa saved twelve thousand dollars on the same paycheck and bills.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split scene, left side heath with thin savings, right side willa with a savings app reading TWELVE THOUSAND in big green numbers, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Auto transfer savings on payday. Pay future you first. Drop and give me twenty bucks!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named coach vault, athletic build, buzzcut brown hair, red track jacket with gold dollar sign logo, silver whistle, clipboard covered in dollar sign stickers, fingerless training gloves, sweatband, coach vault blowing a whistle, holding a clipboard reading SAVINGS FIRST, comic burst banner reads TWENTY BUCKS, kids comic book illustration
